articles.abstract_en: We experimentally compare mediated (cheap) talk with direct (cheap) talk. Theory, guided by a characterization of equilibria in both environments, suggests that mediated talk has the potential to improve information sharing and welfare relative to direct talk. We sharpen the theory prediction by invoking Crawford's (2003) language-anchored level-k analysis. In the experiment, we find that mediated talk can indeed facilitate information transmission. We also find, however, that this requires that the language employed conforms with the mediation mechanism: mediation mechanisms improve information sharing for a variety of conforming languages, but fail to do so with a nonconforming language. These experimental findings match the predictions from the language-anchored level-k analysis. Strikingly, this is the case even when a whole array of alternative selection criteria (including iterative deletion of dominated strategies, strict equilibrium, Pareto efficiency, etc.) make a unique common prediction that sharply disagrees with the language-anchored level-k prediction.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验比较了中介性（廉价）谈话与直接（廉价）谈话。理论，以两种环境中的均衡特征为指导，表明相对于直接谈话，中介性谈话有潜力改善信息共享和福利。我们通过引用Crawford（2003）的语言锚定层级-k分析来强化理论预测。在实验中，我们发现中介性谈话确实可以促进信息传递。然而，我们也发现，这要求所使用的语言符合中介机制：中介机制对于各种符合性语言都能改善信息共享，但对于不符合性语言则无法做到。这些实验发现与语言锚定层级-k分析的预测相符。令人惊讶的是，即使当一系列替代选择标准（包括剔除劣势策略的迭代、严格均衡、帕累托效率等）做出与语言锚定层级-k预测尖锐分歧的独特共同预测时，情况也是如此。

articles.title_en: Optimal orchestration of rewards and punishments in rank-order contests
articles.title_cn: 排名竞赛中奖励与惩罚的最优编排
articles.abstract_en: We allow negative prizes and investigate effort-maximizing prize design in rank-order contests with incomplete information. Endogenous participation arises due to less-efficient types' incentive to avoid punishments. The optimum features winner-take-all for the best performer and at most one punishment for the worst performer among all potential contestants, whenever they enter the competition. Based on this, we then (1) provide a necessary and sufficient condition for the optimality of pure winner-take-all without punishment; and (2) show that the optimal entry threshold increases with the total number of contestants and converges to the Myerson cutoff in the limit. Finally, we characterize the optimal entry-dependent prize structure, allowing the prize sequence to vary with the number of entrants. The optimal design must entail endogenous entry, and it harmonically integrates both winner-take-all and egality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们允许负奖金，并研究不完全信息下排名竞赛中努力最大化的奖金设计。内生参与源于低效率类型避免惩罚的激励。最优方案具有以下特征：最佳表现者获得赢家通吃，且在所有潜在参赛者中，只要他们进入竞赛，最多对最差表现者施加一次惩罚。基于此，我们随后（1）提供了纯赢家通吃而无惩罚的最优性的必要且充分条件；（2）表明最优进入门槛随参赛者总数增加而提高，并在极限情况下收敛于迈尔森截断值。最后，我们刻画了最优的进入依赖奖金结构，允许奖金序列随进入者数量变化。最优设计必须包含内生进入，并和谐地整合了赢家通吃和平等主义。

articles.abstract_en: Whom should an interest group lobby in a legislature? I develop a model of informational lobbying, in which a legislature must decide on the allocation of district-specific goods and projects. An interest group chooses to search and provide information on districts' valuations of the goods. The setting is one of distributive politics, where the proposed allocation of goods and projects is endogenous to the information provided by the interest group. I characterize the information search strategy of the interest group. I furthermore establish that the relationship between informational lobbying and legislative majority requirement is non-monotonic. I also determine who gains and who loses from lobbying, identifying circumstances in which legislators would unanimously prefer to ban informational lobbying. Finally, I provide an informational rationale for why interest groups sometimes lobby legislative allies (friendly lobbying).
articles.abstract_cn: 利益集团在立法机构中应游说谁？我建立了一个信息游说模型，其中立法机构必须决定地区特定商品和项目的分配。利益集团选择搜索并提供关于各地区对商品估价的信息。该设定属于分配政治，其中商品和项目的拟议分配内生于利益集团提供的信息。我刻画了利益集团的信息搜索策略。此外，我证明了信息游说与立法多数要求之间的关系是非单调的。我还确定了谁从游说中获益、谁受损，并识别了立法者一致倾向于禁止信息游说的情形。最后，我为利益集团有时游说立法盟友（友好游说）提供了信息层面的解释。

articles.title_cn: 带有复制品的卢斯模型
articles.abstract_en: We propose the notion of replicas in the context of discrete choices and introduce axioms that characterize the Luce model with replicas. This model does not fall prey to the well-known “red bus-blue bus” example originally proposed by Debreu (1960) and later made famous by McFadden. Our model satisfies regularity, strong stochastic transitivity, and is a random utility model. Due to its simplicity, this model is more parsimonious than others aimed at overcoming the “duplicates problem”.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了离散选择背景下复制品的概念，并引入了刻画带有复制品的卢斯模型的公理。该模型不会陷入由Debreu（1960）最初提出、后由McFadden使之闻名的“红巴士-蓝巴士”例子。我们的模型满足正则性、强随机传递性，并且是一个随机效用模型。由于其简单性，该模型比旨在克服“重复问题”的其他模型更为简约。

articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates a two-agent mechanism design problem without transfers, where the principal must decide one action for each agent. In our framework, agents only care about their own adaptation, and any deterministic dominant incentive compatible decision rule is equivalent to contingent delegation: the delegation set offered to one agent depends on the other's report. By contrast, the principal cares about both adaptation and coordination. We provide sufficient conditions under which contingent interval delegation is optimal and solve the optimal contingent interval delegation under fairly general conditions. Remarkably, the optimal interval delegation is completely determined by combining and modifying the solutions to a class of simple single-agent problems, where the other agent is assumed to report truthfully and choose his most preferred action.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个无转移支付的两代理人机制设计问题，其中委托人必须为每个代理人决定一个行动。在我们的框架中，代理人只关心自身的适应性，任何确定性占优激励相容决策规则都等价于或有委托：提供给一个代理人的委托集合取决于另一个代理人的报告。相比之下，委托人既关心适应性也关心协调性。我们提供了在或有区间委托最优的充分条件，并在相当一般的条件下求解了最优或有区间委托。值得注意的是，最优区间委托完全由一类简单单代理人问题的解组合和修改决定，其中假设另一个代理人如实报告并选择其最偏好的行动。

articles.title_en: Rational inattention in the frequency domain
articles.abstract_en: This paper solves a dynamic rational inattention problem by formulating it in the frequency domain. The main result is a rational inattention version of the classical Wiener-Kolmogorov filter. This filter permits an infinite-dimensional state vector, provides a new line of attack for obtaining closed-form solutions, and can be implemented numerically using a simple iterative algorithm. The frequency-domain approach also sheds new light on why rational inattention produces forward-looking behavior: inattentive agents are willing to accept more uncertainty about the timing of disturbances in exchange for less uncertainty about fluctuations at the most important frequencies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过在频域中构建动态理性疏忽问题来求解该问题。主要结果是经典维纳-科尔莫戈罗夫滤波器的理性疏忽版本。该滤波器允许无限维状态向量，为获得闭式解提供了新的途径，并可通过简单的迭代算法进行数值实现。频域方法还揭示了理性疏忽为何会产生前瞻性行为的新见解：疏忽的代理人愿意接受更多关于扰动时点的不确定性，以换取在最重要频率上波动的不确定性减少。

articles.title_en: On the foundations of competitive search equilibrium with and without market makers
articles.title_cn: 论有无市场做市商的竞争性搜索均衡的基础
articles.abstract_en: The literature offers two interpretations of competitive search equilibrium, one based on a Nash approach and the other on a market-maker approach. When each buyer visits only one seller, the two approaches are equivalent. However, when each buyer visits multiple sellers, this equivalence can break down. We present a model in which every buyer visits 2 sellers. A buyer who trades with one seller receives a value of s, while a buyer who trades with 2 sellers receives value 1. Letting s vary from 0 (perfect complements) to 1 (perfect substitutes) we characterize the competitive search equilibrium under the two interpretations. We show that for low values of s, the Nash and market-maker competitive search equilibria coincide, but the common equilibrium is inefficient. For intermediate values of s, the two equilibria again coincide and are efficient. Finally, for high values of s, the Nash and market-maker equilibria differ, and only the latter is efficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 文献对竞争性搜索均衡提供了两种解释，一种基于纳什方法，另一种基于市场做市商方法。当每个买家只访问一个卖家时，这两种方法是等价的。然而，当每个买家访问多个卖家时，这种等价性可能会被打破。我们提出了一个模型，其中每个买家访问2个卖家。与一个卖家交易的买家获得价值s，而与2个卖家交易的买家获得价值1。让s从0（完全互补）变化到1（完全替代），我们刻画了两种解释下的竞争性搜索均衡。我们表明，对于较低的s值，纳什和市场做市商的竞争性搜索均衡重合，但共同均衡是无效率的。对于中间的s值，两种均衡再次重合且是有效率的。最后，对于较高的s值，纳什和市场做市商的均衡不同，且只有后者是有效率的。

articles.title_en: Renegotiation and dynamic inconsistency: Contracting with non-exponential discounting
articles.title_cn: 重新谈判与动态不一致：非指数贴现下的契约设计
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a continuous-time, finite-horizon contracting problem with renegotiation and dynamic inconsistency arising from non-exponential discounting. The problem is formulated as a dynamic game played among the agent, the principal and their respective future “selves”, each with their own discount function. We identify the principal optimal renegotiation-proof contract as a Markov perfect equilibrium (MPE) of the game, prove that such an MPE exists, and characterize the optimal contract via an extended Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman system. We solve the optimal contract in closed-form when discounting is a function of the time-difference only and demonstrate the applicability of the results in several different settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了连续时间、有限期限的重新谈判契约问题，该问题源于非指数贴现导致的动态不一致。该问题被构建为代理人、委托人及其各自未来“自我”之间的动态博弈，每个参与者都有自己的贴现函数。我们确定了委托人最优的防重新谈判契约作为博弈的马尔可夫完美均衡（MPE），证明了该MPE的存在性，并通过扩展的Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman系统刻画了最优契约。当贴现函数仅依赖于时间差时，我们以闭式解形式求解了最优契约，并在多个不同情境中展示了结果的适用性。

articles.title_en: A new approach to the uniqueness of equilibrium with CRRA preferences
articles.title_cn: 具有CRRA偏好的均衡唯一性新方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the uniqueness of equilibrium in the economy where agents have preferences with possibly distinct levels of relative risk aversion. Equilibrium prices exist in a price range determined by micro and macroeconomic information. Macroeconomic information is inferred from two representative-agent economies, which provide lower and upper bounds on aggregate demand, respectively. Analysis of the first and second-order price effects shows that individual demand has a unique inflection point at which the income effect maximally dominates the substitution effect. In contrast, aggregate demand may have multiple inflection points, which creates multiple equilibria. Sufficient conditions for the uniqueness of equilibrium are characterized by the local behavior of individual demand at the inflection point. They require that aggregate demand must have no more than two inflection points in the equilibrium price range. The result of this paper sheds light on the Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu theory that has negative implications for the uniqueness of equilibrium.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在代理人具有可能不同相对风险厌恶水平的偏好经济中均衡的唯一性。均衡价格存在于由微观和宏观经济信息确定的价格范围内。宏观经济信息从两个代表性代理人经济中推断得出，它们分别提供了总需求的下界和上界。对一阶和二阶价格效应的分析表明，个体需求在收入效应最大程度主导替代效应的点上具有唯一的拐点。相比之下，总需求可能具有多个拐点，这导致了多重均衡。均衡唯一性的充分条件由个体需求在拐点处的局部行为刻画。这些条件要求总需求在均衡价格范围内不得有多于两个拐点。本文的结果对Sonnenschein-Mantel-Debreu理论中关于均衡唯一性的负面含义提供了新的见解。

articles.abstract_en: We offer an approach to cooperation in repeated games of private monitoring in which players construct models of their opponents' behavior by observing the frequencies of play in a record of past plays of the game in which actions but not signals are recorded. Players construct models of their opponent's behavior by grouping the histories in the record into a relatively small number of analogy classes for which they estimate probabilities of cooperation. The incomplete record and the limited number of analogy classes lead to misspecified models that provide the incentives to cooperate. We provide conditions for the existence of equilibria supporting cooperation and equilibria supporting high payoffs for some nontrivial analogy partitions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提出了一种在私人监测的重复博弈中实现合作的方法，其中参与者通过观察博弈过去记录中行动（而非信号）的频率来构建对手行为的模型。参与者通过将记录中的历史划分为相对较少的类比类别来构建对手行为的模型，并估计这些类别中的合作概率。不完整的记录和有限的类比类别导致了错误设定的模型，这些模型为合作提供了激励。我们为支持合作的均衡以及在某些非平凡类比划分下支持高收益的均衡的存在性提供了条件。

articles.title_en: Ambiguous information and dilation: An experiment
articles.title_cn: 模糊信息与扩张：一项实验
articles.abstract_en: With standard models of updating under ambiguity, new information may increase the amount of relevant ambiguity: the set of beliefs may ‘dilate.’ We experimentally test one sharp case: agents bet on a risky urn and get information that is truthful or not based on the draw from an Ellsberg urn. With common models, the set of beliefs dilates, and the value of bets decreases for ambiguity-averse agents and increases for ambiguity-seeking ones. Instead, we find that the value of bets does not change for ambiguity-averse individuals, while it increases substantially for ambiguity-seeking ones. We also test bets on ambiguous urns, in which case we find sizable reactions to ambiguous information.
articles.abstract_cn: 在模糊性下的标准更新模型中，新信息可能增加相关模糊性的数量：信念集合可能‘扩张’。我们实验性地检验了一个尖锐的情形：代理人押注于一个有风险的瓮，并根据从埃尔斯伯格瓮中抽取的结果获得真实或非真实的信息。在常见模型下，信念集合扩张，对于模糊厌恶的代理人，赌注价值下降，而对于模糊寻求的代理人则上升。相反，我们发现对于模糊厌恶的个体，赌注价值不变，而对于模糊寻求的个体则显著上升。我们还测试了押注于模糊瓮的情况，在这种情况下，我们发现对模糊信息有显著的反应。

articles.title_en: Fostering collusion through action revision in duopolies
articles.title_cn: 通过行动修订促进双头垄断中的合谋
articles.abstract_en: We design an experiment to study the implications of allowing players to revise their actions in a Cournot duopoly game. Payoffs are determined only by the quantities selected at the end in a real-time revision game. On the other hand, in a stochastic revision game, opportunities to adjust quantities arrive randomly, and the quantities selected at the last revision opportunity are implemented. Contrasting results emerge: while real-time revision results in choices that are more competitive than the static Cournot-Nash, significantly lower quantities are implemented when revisions are stochastic. The results hold for different arrival rates of revision opportunities. Our findings demonstrate that the ability to revise actions can sustain partial cooperation. Although quantity adjustment choices display substantial heterogeneity, the main implication of the theory of revision games put forth by Kamada and Kandori (2020) is supported.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个实验来研究在古诺双头垄断博弈中允许玩家修订其行动的含义。在实时修订博弈中，收益仅由结束时选择的产量决定。另一方面，在随机修订博弈中，调整产量的机会随机到达，并且实施的是在最后一次修订机会时选择的产量。出现了对比鲜明的结果：实时修订导致的选择比静态古诺-纳什更具竞争性，而当修订是随机时，实施的产量显著更低。这些结果对于不同的修订机会到达率均成立。我们的发现表明，修订行动的能力可以维持部分合作。尽管产量调整选择显示出显著的异质性，但Kamada和Kandori（2020）提出的修订博弈理论的主要含义得到了支持。

articles.title_en: Schumpeterian competition in a Lucas economy
articles.title_cn: 卢卡斯经济中的熊彼特竞争
articles.abstract_en: We model a rent-seeking game where agents experiment with a new technology and compete for claims to a consumption stream. We characterize how creative destruction affects risk, wealth, and asset prices. Competition not only imposes excessive disruption risk on existing assets and higher technological uncertainty, it also increases the wealth duration (the weighted-average maturity of wealth). Because of hedging motives, a complementarity between wealth duration and technological uncertainty decreases systematic risk. If competition is sufficiently intense, a negative risk premium may arise. The model generates price paths consistent with boom-bust patterns and transient episodes of negative expected excess returns. We show that Schumpeterian competition may worsen income inequality.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个寻租博弈模型，其中经济主体尝试新技术并争夺消费流的索取权。我们刻画了创造性破坏如何影响风险、财富和资产价格。竞争不仅给现有资产带来过度的破坏风险并提高技术不确定性，还增加了财富久期（财富的加权平均到期期限）。由于对冲动机，财富久期与技术不确定性之间的互补性降低了系统性风险。如果竞争足够激烈，可能会出现负的风险溢价。该模型生成的价格路径与繁荣-萧条模式以及负的预期超额收益的短暂时期相一致。我们表明，熊彼特竞争可能加剧收入不平等。

articles.title_en: Regulatory mechanism design with extortionary collusion
articles.title_cn: 含勒索性合谋的监管机制设计
articles.abstract_en: We study regulatory mechanism design with collusion between a privately informed agent and a less well-informed supervisor, incorporating ‘extortion’ which permits redistribution of rents within the coalition. We show the Collusion Proof Principle holds, and that the allocation of bargaining power between the supervisor and agent matters. Specifically, the Principal does not benefit from hiring the supervisor if the latter has less bargaining power vis-a-vis the agent. We provide an example where hiring the supervisor is valuable if she has greater bargaining power. These results indicate the importance of anti-collusion strategies that augment bargaining power of supervisors vis-a-vis agents.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了监管机制设计中，私人信息代理人与信息较不充分的监管者之间的合谋问题，并纳入了允许联盟内部租金再分配的“勒索”行为。我们证明了合谋证明原理成立，且监管者与代理人之间的议价能力分配至关重要。具体而言，如果监管者相对于代理人的议价能力较弱，委托人不会从雇佣监管者中获益。我们提供了一个例子，说明当监管者拥有更强的议价能力时，雇佣监管者是有价值的。这些结果表明，增强监管者相对于代理人议价能力的反合谋策略具有重要意义。

articles.title_en: Evolutionary foundation for heterogeneity in risk aversion
articles.title_cn: 风险厌恶异质性的演化基础
articles.abstract_en: We examine the evolutionary basis for risk aversion with respect to aggregate risk. We study populations in which agents face choices between alternatives with different levels of aggregate risk. We show that the choices that maximize the long-run growth rate are induced by a heterogeneous population in which the least and most risk-averse agents are indifferent between facing an aggregate risk and obtaining its linear and harmonic mean for sure, respectively. Moreover, approximately optimal behavior can be induced by a simple distribution according to which all agents have constant relative risk aversion, and the coefficient of relative risk aversion is uniformly distributed between zero and two.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了针对总体风险的风险厌恶的演化基础。我们研究了面临不同总体风险水平选择的人群。我们表明，最大化长期增长率的抉择是由一个异质性人群引发的，在该人群中，风险厌恶程度最低和最高的个体分别对面对总体风险与确定获得其线性均值和调和均值无差异。此外，近似最优行为可以通过一个简单的分布引发，根据该分布，所有个体都具有常数相对风险厌恶，且相对风险厌恶系数在零和二之间均匀分布。

articles.title_en: Rational inattention when decisions take time
articles.title_cn: 当决策需要时间时的理性疏忽
articles.abstract_en: Decisions take time, and the time taken to reach a decision is likely to be informative about the cost of more precise judgments. We formalize this insight using a dynamic model of optimal evidence accumulation. We provide conditions under which the resulting belief dynamics resemble either diffusion processes or processes with large jumps. We then consider the in which discounting effects are small relative to the opportunity cost of time, and show that the state-contingent choice probabilities predicted by our model are identical to those predicted by a static rational inattention model, providing a micro-foundation for such models. In the diffusion case, our model provides a normative foundation for a variant of the drift-diffusion model from mathematical psychology.
articles.abstract_cn: 决策需要时间，而做出决策所花费的时间可能反映了更精确判断的成本。我们使用最优证据积累的动态模型来形式化这一见解。我们提供了条件，在这些条件下，由此产生的信念动态类似于扩散过程或具有大跳跃的过程。然后，我们考虑贴现效应相对于时间机会成本较小的情况，并表明我们的模型预测的状态依赖选择概率与静态理性疏忽模型预测的相同，为这类模型提供了微观基础。在扩散情况下，我们的模型为数学心理学中的漂移扩散模型变体提供了规范基础。

articles.abstract_en: We develop a theory of financial innovation in which both market structure and the payoffs of the claims being traded are determined endogenously. Intermediaries use the cash flows of an underlying asset to design securities for investors. Demand for securities arises as investors choose markets then trade using strategies represented by quantity-price schedules. We show that intermediaries create increasingly riskier asset-backed securities when facing deeper markets in which investors trade more competitively. In turn, investors elicit less risky securities when they choose thinner markets, revealing a novel role for market fragmentation in the creation of safer securities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们发展了一个金融创新理论，其中市场结构和所交易权益的收益都是内生决定的。中介机构利用基础资产的现金流为投资者设计证券。对证券的需求产生于投资者选择市场，然后使用由数量-价格计划表代表的策略进行交易。我们表明，当面对投资者交易更具竞争性的更深市场时，中介机构会创造风险越来越高的资产支持证券。反过来，当投资者选择更薄的市场时，他们会引出风险较低的证券，这揭示了市场碎片化在创造更安全证券中的新作用。
